description: ARM64 architecture-specific reset and initialization routines for different exception levels in Zephyr OS.

methods.name: z_arm64_el_highest_init
methods.description: Initializes the highest exception level, setting system counter frequency and calling platform-specific init.

methods.name: z_arm64_el3_init
methods.description: Initializes EL3, sets up vector table, security, and system registers, and handles EL2 skipping if needed.

methods.name: z_arm64_el2_init
methods.description: Initializes EL2, configures system control registers, and platform-specific init.

methods.name: z_arm64_el1_init
methods.description: Initializes EL1, sets up vector table, cache, and floating point access.

methods.name: z_arm64_el3_get_next_el
methods.description: Prepares the SPSR and ELR registers for transitioning from EL3 to the next exception level.
